notes.title: Venba now supports Macs!
notes.content:
Venba is now available on the Mac!
Hello![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/01ce8dd41b07298be7a0a3012be002d7d10c0db6.png"]

Hope you've all been doing well. We're super excited to announce that Venba is now available on the Mac. A significant portion of players have been asking for this feature for a while, and we wanted to implement it sooner, but it took us a bit to work out some kinks while simultaneously developing our next game.

Regardless, it's here now, and we'd love to provide one more option for players who couldn't otherwise play Venba!

If you have any thoughts about Venba or want to know what we're working on next, we have a thriving community we would like you to join here:
https://discord.gg/GSwn92Wu2z

notes.title: Game 2 News!
notes.content:
Hi all!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/69d91991a3b0effb40fb55eee842a114193db4b6.jpg

Ecstatic to announce that after the success of Venba, Game 2 is now in development! We've partnered with the amazing people from Outersloth to bring you all a brand-new game rooted in ancient Sangam-era Tamil culture.

To keep you all updated, we've launched a Discord server that you can join here!

We wouldn't have made it this far if it wasn't for your love for Venba. We hope you'll all join us for this next adventure too. From the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU!

(PSST. We've also got some exciting Venba news coming your way soon!)

notes.title: Venba is 60% off and we have some avatars for you all!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/38c1fcdfe5cccf7aac603408e3105594937baf82.png

 60% off, our Biggest Discount yet!! 

Venba is 60% off with its biggest discount yet!!!! We're nearing 2 years since Venba launched and its still going strong. We're really happy with how it's resonated with so many of you. For others who haven't picked it up yet, this is a great chance to do so!


Animated Avatars!! 
We also have an exciting update for players who already own the game on Steam! We thought it would be fun to have animated profile avatars featuring some of the characters from the game for you all to use!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/9964707c9caa91921c451e5afb39372b706a4271.gif
Of course, we have the titular character herself. Elegant, kind and loves food to a fault, Venba can now be your steam avatar!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/11901e5ae2ba1fb7e303f79bee51ef78235e184f.gif
You all remember the mask from the game right? Well, the mask definitely remembers you. Stare long enough and you might just catch it in the act of being not so still. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/c97d0239c04fd11f260ada1cfb4a03addfbbdd84.gif
The arsenal found in Venba's kitchen! We thought it would be fun to have some of the common ingredients animated as a frame for your profile picture!

We're so so excited to share this update with you all. Let us know if you want to see more of this kind of thing and we can definitely look into adding more.

Meanwhile, you can checkout our progress and keep up with what we're upto next on Bluesky, Instagram and TikTok. If you're there, give us a follow!

notes.title: PEABODY and Indie Game Utsav!
notes.content:
Hello hello!

First off, some exciting news! 

Venba has been nominated for a PEABODY award!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/c7679930ab35718059a2f004179bc4f8ac347c70.jpg

This is a huge honor for us and it's really cool to see more and more recognition for video games as a whole from so many prestigious institutions! We're also in great company with games like 1000xRESIST who are our good friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/29b78597d9386f242c299df6d4d3b3ef8d9ad56f.jpg

Next up! The developers of Raji: An Ancient Epic, have put together an amazing festival called the Indie Game Utsav which celebrates games from India! This is the first time an event like this is run and highlights indie developers from India who are making some very cool titles. 

Finally, we also wanted to ask you all if you would be interested in more ways of hearing from us! We're gauging interest in building maybe a newsletter or a discord server so you can keep with us and what we're upto next. We do have a lot to show soon ;)

notes.title: Venba is up for TWO Game Awards!
notes.content:
Venba is nominated for Best Debut Indie Game and Games for Impact at this year's Game Awards!

Now that we've recovered from our speechlessness, we're absolutely thrilled to announce that our game is nominated for not one, but TWO whole Game Awards! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/c26e117d1114ef939c0cd5d779e3b3a93ac75d8a.jpg

In the three years we spent developing Venba, we never thought it would resonate with so many people. So, before we say anything more, we want to thank you for playing our game. We wouldn't be here without you.

We're in the company of some incredible nominees this year. That said, if you or someone you know enjoyed Venba, please consider voting for us.

You can head to The Game Awards website to vote for us in the  Best Debut Indie Game and Games for Impact categories!

Voting closes December 6th!

Thank you for all your love and support. <3

notes.title: New Content Alert! Venba's Cookbook is coming!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/47125c65651803177ed3ce5f068abf0d349cd6cc.png

In our first major post-launch update, our players will get access to a long-awaited feature!

Access to Venba's cookbook...
...including recipes for ALL the South Indian dishes you cook in the game!

Thanks to Venba and Kavin's hard-work in restoring the cookbook, you'll soon be able to access all the recipes in game. From dosa to biryani to murruku, we can't wait for you to cook all these mouthwatering dishes... now in real life.

Which dish are you looking forward to cooking? Let us know in the replies!

Stay tuned for more information!

notes.title: Sale Alert: Get 15% off on Venba until 10/23!
notes.content:
Let's get cooking.
It's time for a sale! Venba, our narrative cooking game, is available for 15% off for the next 7 days. Including the Deluxe Edition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/c6f009ae48a9b86e0d1681a243b120fd5ea3efa3.png

Play as the titular Venba, an immigrant mother, and cook authentic South Indian dishes for your family. From fluffy idlis, crispy dosas, all the way to mouthwatering, aromatic biryani... each dish you cook takes you on a heartfelt journey about family, love, and loss.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/60b48543ca282d2f835d5ed24655ed7d0c5b0d25.png

If you've been meaning to play Venba (or gift it to your loved ones), now's the time! We hope you enjoy cooking with Venba, Kavin, and Paavalan. We can't wait to hear your thoughts!

notes.title: July Update: Biriyani Level
notes.content:
Hi all!

We’re back with another development update. This time, we’ve wrapped up a chapter of the story featuring one of the most popular Indian dishes of all time:  Biriyani!

Biriyani is a dish that’s found throughout India and there are a variety of ways to prepare it. For this level, we’ve tried a homestyle approach to the legendary layered Hyderabadi Dum Biriyani.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/49b13ddfb4bb8d2a3a3dde1193b71396f2bfa0de.gif

We are also introducing the Memory Mechanic in this level! Unlike previous levels, the recipe is not partially ruined - it’s completely unreadable. Instead, Venba has to recall the memory of making biriyani with her mother to finish this important dish before her son leaves for university. 

It’s an important moment in the family’s life. The child they stayed in Canada to raise has grown up and is leaving the nest, and it’s hard on Venba and Paavalan to see him go.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/11f300c4c9e320698eac021c57d24aad102a7a25.gif

notes.title: May Update: Park Level
notes.content:
Hello! Long time no see, everyone. We’ve been hard at work for the past few months, heads down trying to get the game feature complete. 3 new levels have been developed, and today we’re going to talk about one of the most unique levels in the game.

This level is the only one in the game with no cooking component to the gameplay. Paavalan doesn’t come home on time one day, and you get to see Venba and Kavin problem solving to try and figure out where he is.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/e6f4815a0b1bf67e1b122b559c43024e4b888cb0.jpg

It’s also a level that has some darker aspects to the story. We put a spotlight on Venba’s husband, Paavalan, and to learn more about his day to day life and challenges. 

Venba is heavily inspired by Tamil movies. For this level in particular, we tried to direct the cinematics in a way such that it will be reminiscent of the movies it draws inspiration from. To achieve this, the music was integral. Alpha Something, the music director, created a special song for this level that was recorded in a live studio with a local band and a lot of effort went into syncing up the visuals to the music. We’re really happy with how this level turned out and we can’t wait for you all to play it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/71883c249282e50cc93ceae04cc655426f49d5a1.png

notes.title: October Update: Idlis
notes.content:
Hello!!
We're back with an update for October. We have wrapped yet another level, and this time it's the first level players will be playing, and it features Idlis!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/4e119eeaa45ea095c34c242c485ad096e6e88ec2.png


Idlis are made from steaming idli batter (made from rice and urad dal) and are a prevalent breakfast staple in South India. It's so popular that we almost wanted to avoid showcasing something so typical, but in the end, it didn't feel right to make a game about Tamil cuisine without idlis in them. 

 I've grown quite fond of this level because the puzzle design draws almost entirely from the utensils and equipment used to make idlis. It's almost as if there was already a puzzle in the process of making idlis, and we had to obfuscate the correct information.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/9e7f434fef679460fec9c3db187f63191b7a4a93.png

Since it's the first level, players will meet Venba and Paavalan for the first time.  At this point in their lives, they're questioning their lives in Canada and are anxious about their future when they receive some surprising news. The narrative and the cooking tie together here really well, and we're excited for when you'll eventually play it!

With the idli level behind us, we're moving forward with the next level, which will play quite differently from the rest of the game.  More on that on the next update!

notes.title: Venba: September Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/47125c65651803177ed3ce5f068abf0d349cd6cc.png
Hello! 
Venba has been cooking for a while, so we thought it was time we posted a development update and the game's status.  

The team just wrapped up a playable level where players will cook a delicious dish famous in Kerala called "Puttu." Puttu is made from steamed rice flour and grated coconuts.  It's a simple and delicious dish to cook, and it's often served for breakfast. It's most commonly served with kadalai kari (A side dish made with Chickpeas, onions, masalas and more!), but it can also be served with things like beef/chicken kari.
It is a very versatile dish with a lot of variations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/3abef0220f5375091b1838afbba0288cc036a022.png

​​This is maybe the biggest and most complicated level in the game. It contains some of the most complex animations and dynamic scenes in the game. The gameplay also required special scripting as making puttu is a unique process. 

We had a lot of fun building this level, and it made us even happier when we saw how much fun our playtesters had with it! Tackling a complex level like this also gives us a lot of confidence for building the rest of the game. We can't wait for you all to cook puttu along with the other wonderful dishes in Venba!

With the puttu level behind us, we're firing on all cylinders for the next level, where players will be making the iconic breakfast staple, Idlis. We will share more about that level once it's complete!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39360174/b51907f1160731fe772585bff91d9eadddd0fe27.jpg
